description: Shipping AND receiving: one custody record per parcel, inbound or outbound - the mailroom and the dock. ship posts the freight entry; exceptions are tasks. The custody walks: search_guides.

op.description: create | update | receive | pickup | ship | get | list.

contents.description: Informational; counts go through manage_po receive.

tracking.description: Carrier tracking id; known carriers get a link.

recipient.description: contact_id the parcel is for; arrival notifies, pickup closes.

po_id.description: The PO fulfilled; counted in via manage_po receive.

invoice_id.description: The invoice an outbound shipment fulfills.

cost.description: Freight: Dr SHIPPING_EXPENSE at ship (outbound) or receive (inbound); omit if not paid by the firm.

signed_by.description: Who signed at receive or pickup.

condition.description: On arrival; damage or shortage becomes a task.

status.description: list: filter. update: exception|cancelled from any open state.

open.description: list: in-flight, on-dock or awaiting pickup.

updates.description: update: field to value; direction, freight_entry, created_at immutable.
